[Section] Experiments ::: 20 newsgroups
[source_id=37] 20 newsgroups data set is one of the frequently used datasets in the text processing community for text classification and text clustering. This data set contains approximately 20,000 English documents from 20 topics to be identified, with 11314 documents for training and 7532 for testing. In this work, we used only 90% of documents for training and the remaining 10% for validation. For fair comparison with other publications, we used 53160 words vocabulary set available in the datasets website.
